pins.name: RX
pins.notes: UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin

pins.name: TX
pins.notes: UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin (9600 baud)

gotchas.text: The first fix needs a view of the sky and takes about 30 seconds or more. Indoors it may never find one.
It talks at 9600 baud. Connect the module’s TX to the board’s RX.
